name: HARDWARE
text:
If you’re looking for replacement parts or upgrades to your infrared sauna hardware you’ve come to the right place.

Your sauna contains a lot of different hardware parts. Some are ornamental, others are functional and most of these parts are replaceable or upgradeable. To create a positive environment in the infrared sauna is a part of being owner of an infrared sauna.

Knobs, door handles, side latches and other parts contribute to the overall sauna experience. It’s not just about beauty but also about functionality. Due to specifics of infrared saunas, standard household hardware would not be suitable so we provide a choice of parts for you to choose from.

If something is broken or if some parts are not working correctly, you can find a replacement here.

We are looking forward to helping you fix or upgrade your sauna.
text_short:
Door accessories can change the entire look of sauna doors. Be it knobs, locks, door handles or side latches, all details have to be perfect in order to give your infrared sauna beautiful and neat look.

Standard household door hardware is not suitable for infrared sauna. Sauna doors need to be closed at all times to save energy and keep sauna hot, so it is necessary to find special lock mechanisms and padlock latches.
